decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 2 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.

Condition : 3 - All replacement and new brickwork, pointing, fireplaces and joinery shall be in accordance with Technical Notes 1, 3, and 5 of the Bedford Park Society's Guidance for residents and architects.

Condition : 4 - New arched heads to the windows shall be true segmental arches, not supported on visible lintols. The windows shall be set back as elsewhere on the elevation. Before insertion of the windows in the side gable is carried out the applicant shall confirm in writing via a structural engineer that the building will remain structurally secure.

Condition : 5 - Unless otherwise agreed with the local planning authority, the windows shall be single glazed, puttied, although weather stripped. This is to be made known to Building Control as a historic waiver.

Condition : 6 - Before the relevant part of the work is commenced, further details shall be submitted of the eaves to the utility room and gutter to a scale of not less than 1:20. The works shall be completed according to the further details approved by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - Before the relevant part of the development is commenced, trial areas of paint stripping/painting removal shall be carried out in accordance with details to be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 8 - Before the relevant part of the works hereby approved is commenced a full survey report of the original fireplaces shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority for archive purposes.
description: Internal and external refurbishments and alterations including reconstruction of rear addition incorporating new window and door, roof terrace and balustrade above and projecting ground floor bay window. Demolition of garage and erection of single storey side extension incorporating rooflight. Rebuilding of chimney stack, new windows to flank elevation including new window to loft space.
